Features

One UI to easily track, discover, buy and swap your inscriptions

$SSNC Token

$SSNC is the native token in the SatoshiSync ecosystem offering the following key utilities:

Cross Chain Revenue Capture/fees

Holders of the $SSNC token will receive revenue generated from cross-chain fees on SatoshiSync Platform

Deflationary

Total supply of $SSNC token will decrease over time through the burning mechanism

Staking for Rewards

Users can stake $SSNC tokens to earn rewards in the form of RC20 tokens.

By staking their $SSNC tokens, participants contribute to the platform’s liquidity and security while receiving additional token rewards in return

Governance/Voting Rights

$SSNC token holders can shape the future of the RC20 ecosystem by participating in governance of the SatoshiSync platform.
